name: Messel Pit Fossil Site
description: Messel Pit is a former oil-shale mine near Darmstadt in Hesse, central Germany. Its layered shale preserves the bottom of an Eocene lake, with fossils roughly 47 million years old. Fully intact skeletons of early mammals turn up here, some with their last meals still in their stomachs, giving a rare glimpse of life shortly after the dinosaurs.
